request.query: Subtract polynomials of equal degree and equal leading coefficients gives lower degree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sub_lt
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.degree = q.degree → p ≠ 0 → p.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff → (p - q).degree < p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.IsMonicOfDegree.natDegree_sub_lt
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 → p.IsMonicOfDegree n → q.IsMonicOfDegree n → (p - q).natDegree < n

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, q.degree < p.degree → (p - q).degree = p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_cancelLeads_lt_of_natDegree_le_natDegree_of_comm
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff * p.leadingCoeff →
    p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree → 0 < q.natDegree → (p.cancelLeads q).natDegree < q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_right_of_degree_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p.degree < q.degree → (p - q).degree = q.degree
